responsibility: Implements application and presentation of diagnostic fix-it hints as editable source changes. This file owns the concrete machinery behind diagnostics::changes::change_set, including per-file and per-line edit tracking, column remapping after earlier edits, generation of updated file contents, and unified-diff style output; it consumes fixit_hint and rich_location data together with file_cache access to original source, and produces either rewritten source text or a printable diff representing the cumulative fix-it effects.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for fix-it change application: it defines the internal changed_file, changed_line, and line_event machinery, applies edits against cached source, computes post-edit columns, generates rewritten content and diffs, and contains this stem’s selftests. In contrast, changes.h only exposes the public change_set API.
